name: Cole Escola
bio: Cole Escola is an American comedian, actor, singer, and playwright. They are best known for their cabaret work and appearances on the television series Difficult People, At Home with Amy Sedaris, Search Party, and Big Mouth, as well as for writing and starring in the play Oh, Mary! which opened on Broadway in 2024.
